verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes one processing clock itself: e-file provider applications can take "up to 45 days" to approve. That is a static maximum for a single transaction type, not a current or live processing-time figure. The evidence shows no published processing times for founder-relevant transactions such as EIN applications filed by mail or fax, or Form 15620/83(b) elections. Missing for 10: current or regularly updated processing times, coverage of founder transaction types (SS-4 mail/fax EIN, 83(b) filings), any status-page or dashboard style publication, independent corroboration.
